title: Quantum Computing for Cryptography
abstract: This paper examines quantum algorithms and their implications for traditional encryption.
full_text: Quantum computing uses qubits and quantum gates to solve certain computational problems. Shor algorithm threatens RSA encryption, while Grover algorithm affects symmetric key security. The paper reviews cryptographic risks and possible defenses.

title: Machine Learning for Cancer Detection
abstract: A study of machine learning techniques for identifying cancer from medical images.
full_text: Convolutional neural networks classify medical scans and detect abnormal tissue. Researchers evaluate accuracy, sensitivity, and false positive rates on annotated imaging datasets.

title: Renewable Energy Forecasting with Neural Networks
abstract: Neural networks are applied to forecast solar and wind energy output.
full_text: Weather observations and historical electricity production are used to train recurrent neural networks. The approach supports grid planning and improves predictions during variable weather.

title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Using Lattices
abstract: An overview of lattice-based algorithms designed to resist quantum attacks.
full_text: Lattice-based cryptography uses hard mathematical problems such as learning with errors. The paper studies key encapsulation, digital signatures, and performance tradeoffs for quantum-resistant communication.

title: Transformers for Medical Report Summarization
abstract: Transformer models summarize long clinical reports for healthcare professionals.
full_text: Attention-based language models process clinical narratives and generate concise summaries. The research measures factual consistency, medical terminology coverage, and clinician usefulness.

title: Climate Change and Coastal Flood Risk
abstract: A geospatial study of coastal flooding under changing climate conditions.
full_text: Satellite observations, sea-level projections, and elevation maps are combined to identify vulnerable coastal areas. The analysis considers storm surges and long-term infrastructure resilience.

title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Scientific Literature
abstract: A RAG system retrieves research articles to ground language model responses.
full_text: Research papers are split into chunks and embedded into a vector index. Semantic retrieval selects relevant passages, which a language model uses to answer scientific questions with supporting citations.

title: Graph Neural Networks for Drug Discovery
abstract: Graph neural networks predict molecular properties relevant to drug development.
full_text: Molecules are represented as graphs with atoms and chemical bonds. Message passing networks estimate molecular toxicity, solubility, and candidate binding properties.

title: FAISS-Based Semantic Search for Academic Papers
abstract: An academic search engine uses dense embeddings and FAISS indexing.
full_text: Titles, abstracts, and full text are transformed into vector embeddings. FAISS retrieves nearest neighbors for natural language queries, while metadata supports filtering and ranking research papers.

title: Cyber Threat Detection with Anomaly Models
abstract: Anomaly detection methods identify suspicious behavior in network traffic.
full_text: Network logs and traffic features are analyzed using isolation forests and autoencoders. The approach highlights unusual connection patterns and evaluates precision and recall.

title: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Small Language Models
abstract: Parameter-efficient techniques reduce compute needs for language model adaptation.
full_text: Low-rank adaptation updates a small subset of trainable parameters while keeping base model weights frozen. Experiments compare memory consumption, task accuracy, and training speed.

title: Explainable AI for Clinical Decision Support
abstract: Explainability methods help clinicians interpret machine learning predictions.
full_text: Feature attribution and local explanations reveal which patient attributes influence model predictions. The paper examines interpretability, clinical trust, and limitations of explanation methods.

title: Secure Federated Learning in Hospitals
abstract: Federated learning enables model training across hospitals without centralizing records.
full_text: Hospitals train local models and share parameter updates rather than raw patient data. Secure aggregation and differential privacy are evaluated for collaborative medical prediction.

title: Quantum Machine Learning for Classification
abstract: Quantum circuits are investigated for supervised classification tasks.
full_text: Parameterized quantum circuits encode input features and are optimized using classical methods. The study compares hybrid quantum-classical classifiers with conventional baselines.

title: Large Language Models for Software Engineering
abstract: Language models assist with code generation and automated debugging.
full_text: The study evaluates code completion, bug localization, unit test generation, and repository-level reasoning. It discusses hallucinated APIs, benchmark leakage, and developer oversight.

title: Recent Advances in Quantum-Resistant Encryption
abstract: Modern encryption protocols are evaluated against potential quantum attacks.
full_text: The paper compares lattice-based key exchange, hash-based signatures, and hybrid cryptographic protocols. It focuses on practical deployment and security migration strategies.

title: Deep Learning for Satellite Image Analysis
abstract: Deep learning models classify land cover from satellite imagery.
full_text: Convolutional and transformer-based vision models identify vegetation, urban regions, and water bodies. Multispectral imagery improves classification of environmental change.

title: Hybrid Search with BM25 and Vector Embeddings
abstract: Hybrid retrieval combines lexical keyword matching with dense semantic search.
full_text: The system retrieves documents using BM25 and vector similarity, then merges candidate rankings. Experiments assess recall, relevance, and ranking quality for scientific search queries.

title: AI Methods for Predicting Heart Disease
abstract: Supervised learning predicts heart disease risk from clinical measurements.
full_text: Logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural networks are trained on patient health indicators. The paper compares calibration, sensitivity, and fairness across patient groups.

title: Evaluation of RAG Systems with Citation Grounding
abstract: Evaluation metrics assess answer faithfulness and retrieval quality in RAG.
full_text: A retrieval-augmented generation pipeline is evaluated using context precision, answer relevance, citation support, and hallucination rate. The study proposes benchmark tasks for research assistants.
